stories.title: Burnham says UK with Ukraine ‘all the way’ despite ‘outrageous threats’ from Russia – Europe live
stories.summary: Burnham continues by saying that “Ukraine has been Europe’s protector, not a drain on our security, but the frontline of keeping Europe safe.” “That’s why I believe the Ukrainian people deserve not just our continued support, but our gratitude and our respect.” He congratulates Ukraine on its Independence Day on behalf of the UK. He repeats that the UK believes recognises Ukraine’s “independence and sovereignty in full,” and believes that “international borders cannot be changed by force.” He tells “the people of this country, from Lviv to Luhansk,… that we are with you in this struggle all the way, heart and soul.” He says he sees “an unbroken country” in Ukraine, as he pledges continued support for Ukraine. “We will continue to build the 100 year partnership between our two countries, bringing together our cities and our schools, our businesses and our communities, learning from each other and growing together for decades to come. And despite Russia’s outrageous threats to my country, we will continue our support for Ukraine’s defence.” The attacks on Chernihiv on Monday are just the latest in Russia’s recent barrage of ballistic attacks. The Guardian’s Dan Sabbagh reports that in July alone – the last full month for which figures are available – 437 civilians were killed across Ukraine and 2,610 injured according to UN figures. It’s the highest number recorded killed since May 2022. “Previously, the Russians would strike the Kyiv region at night.

stories.title: Russian Battlegroup North units push Ukrainian forces back from state border — top brass
stories.summary: The battlegroup's service members continue creating a security zone in the Sumy and Kharkov Regions
article_sentences: Fighters of Russia’s Battlegroup North are pushing the enemy back from the state border after taking control of the Pershe Travnya settlement in the Sumy Region, the Russian Defense Ministry reported.
"During an active offensive operation, Battlegroup North service members took control of the Pershe Travnya settlement in the Sumy Region.

In a mop-up operation in the settlement, units of the 810th Brigade and the 145th Marine Regiment, as well as assault troops from the 15th Tank Regiment and the 41st and 22nd Motorized Rifle Regiments, distinguished themselves the most.

<...> Units of the Battlegroup North, advancing simultaneously along all sectors of the front, continue to push the enemy further and further back from the state border, creating a security zone in the Sumy and Kharkov Regions," the ministry said in a statement.

stories.title: Decoupling footpaths from accidents
stories.summary: Justice Narasimha’s judgment divorces the footpath from the theme of motor accidents. The sole objective of a footpath is not to avoid accidents. The pathways have an identity and a greater purpose of their own
